a note from the heart

A little birthday letter

Hey Manognaaa, happyyyyy birthday! 🌿 May this year bring you more laughs than “idk” replies, more chill moments than stress, and everything you’re lowkey hoping for. You’ve got this weird, funny energy that makes even boring chats interesting — I’m glad it’s part of my day. Hope your day’s as bright and calm as you make things for everyone around you. Less “😑” and more “😆” today — you deserve the good stuff without the drama. Enjoy every bit of it, and don’t forget to actually celebrate yourself. I know I’m bad at mushy stuff, but I’m genuinely glad you’re here. Stay awesome, keep being you, and msg me when you’re free — I’ll make sure this day doesn’t flop like our UNO plans. Celebrate well, okay? 🎉
Your partner-in-crime, always 🤝🎀
